every_position_composed.reason: Both sites use the exact same camera choreography and framing across frames 1 to 9, keeping the 3D pipeline clearly composed on the right of the left-hand card.

explains_the_project.reason: While both share the same instructional 3D assembly line, the second site's brighter floor lighting makes dark machine details like the press frame and cabinet drawers in frames 1, 4, and 5 much easier to read.

craft_of_the_3d.reason: In frames 1 through 9, the second site's lighter slate floor plane reveals crisp cast shadows and grounds the dark industrial machinery far better than the near-black floor in the first site, where dark bases blend into the background.

type_and_layout.reason: Typography, hierarchy, and card layout are identical across all 9 frames on both sites, though both have a missing space in 'ONE20,001-LINE' on the button in frames 1 and 2.

overall.reason: Both sites share the same strong 3D mechanical metaphor and layout, but the second site's lighter floor surface makes shadows, depth, and dark 3D machine forms much clearer and better grounded throughout the scroll.
